description: Give a humanoid character a skeleton and skin weights, as a GLB ready to pose and animate (tripo-rig 45, meshy-rig 35 credits). Humanoids only: two arms, two legs, standing. tripo-rig (default) takes bone_names (mixamo, unity, unreal, vrm) so the engine's own animations play on it; animations adds up to 5 of Tripo's presets in the same job (17 credits each), all in the GLB. meshy-rig returns an FBX, a walk and a run as well. Best on one closed model standing in a T-pose or A-pose; remesh a generated model first, never after. The mesh is a URL, an upload id, a library id or a job id. Waits about 45 s, then returns job_id for get_job.

animations.description: tripo-rig only: preset:idle, preset:walk, preset:run, preset:jump, preset:turn, preset:climb, preset:dive, preset:slash, preset:shoot, preset:hurt, preset:fall.
